t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice given was exploring different options of patterns that might be occuring within the game, such as brown and purple gnomes being linked together. Another point that they were considering was whether the higher paid gnome was the one that had the hat amtching the previous basket. They also considered rainbow order and the height of the hats, but they couldn't note any particular pattern.

vb_textbox.text: I couldn't see a pattern in which gnomes would provide more mushrooms. I think that in each round, certain coloured gnomes had a higher value than others. But at the start of a new round, these seemed to have switched and other colours were the ones of higher value. However, I'm not sure at all if this is the case. At the beginning of the round, I would choose randomly and take mental note of which colours had higher value.
